top_left.description: A fluffy Enantiornithes hatchling with a few stray 'spiky' feathers poking out of a nest made of Conifer needles and moss. It is opening its beak wide as if chirping.

top_right.description: The Enantiornithes perched on a branch of an early fruiting plant, holding a small purple berry in its beak. Its eyes are squeezed shut in a 'tasty' expression.

bottom_left.description: The Enantiornithes tucked into a ball on a high branch of a Ginkgo tree under a starry, deep-blue sky. Only its tail feathers and one sleepy eye are visible.

bottom_right.description: The Enantiornithes splashing in a shallow puddle on top of a 'Chalky white' limestone rock. Water droplets and loose feathers are flying in the air.

visual_logic.lighting: SUNNY_EXPOSED_CINEMATIC with colorful lens flares to enhance the 'reward' feeling for kids.
